title: Troll Romance
start: Speak to Ug at the Troll Stronghold.

requirements.t: If Death Plateau was completed prior to the Troll Warzone update, it must be completed again before Troll Romance can be completed.

items.t: Climbing boots (or Trollheim Teleport or Trollheim tablet)

recommended.t: 4 sets of runes or tablets for Trollheim Teleport (with Eadgar's Ruse)
1 set of runes for God Wars Dungeon Teleport (with The Mighty Fall)
43 Prayer is useful for Protect from Melee
Fremennik round shield to reduce damage taken from troll ranged attacks

rewards.t: A handful of uncut gems from Ug (1 uncut diamond, 2 uncut rubies and 4 uncut emeralds)
A new colour of wieldable flowers

steps.t: Go to the middle level of the Troll Stronghold.

sub.t: Enter the cave entrance from Trollheim and go down one level.
Otherwise, enter the secret entrance from the entrance to Fremennik Slayer Dungeon (fairy ring code AJR) or Death Plateau and go up one level.

steps.t: Talk to Ug on the middle level of the Troll Stronghold. Offer him your help. [Chat: 1 Awww, you poor troll. What seems to be the problem? › 3 Don't worry now. I'll see what I can do. › Accept]
Talk to Aga in the room to the north. [Chat: 2 So... how's your... um... love life? › 1 Errr... I've got to go.]
Talk to Arrg in the same room. [Chat: 2 Your girlfriend said you know where to find Trollweiss?]
Teleport to Burthorpe and talk to Freda in the plateaus west of Burthorpe. [Chat: 1 Do you know where I can find Trollweiss? › ? That's all, thanks.]
Talk to Dunstan east of the Burthorpe lodestone about a sled. [Chat: 2 I need a sled | › 1 Yes.]
Talk to him again to give him a rope, maple or yew logs, and an iron bar.
Use swamp tar on a wax bucket (with a cake tin in your inventory).
Use your wax on the sled.
Enter the cave entrance opposite the ice gate, which is located north-west of the main entrance to Troll Stronghold.

sub.t: Preferably use Trollheim Teleport here if you have it.
Otherwise, you need to go through the Troll Stronghold and past Trollheim.

p: Fork in the road leading to Trollweiss Mountain

steps.t: Head north-west and exit the cave through the crevasse.
Head south, equip your sled and slide through the slope.
After the end of the first part of the ride, pick the Trollweiss flowers west of your location. Do not sled any further south at this point or you will have to climb the mountain again.
Go back and talk to Ug.

steps.sec: The things we do for love...
steps.t: Talk to Arrg and tell him you're here to kill him. The fight will start immediately after that. Arrg also attacks immediately after the teleport, so be prepared. [Chat: 1 I am here to kill you!]
p: A safespot for fighting Arrg, avoiding his melee as well as range attacks.

steps.t: Return to Ug and talk to him.

get_inside.text: The Lunar spell Trollheim Farm Teleport to the roof of the Stronghold, then down the ladder into the stronghold itself
pic: Routes getting to the Troll Stronghold

get_inside.text: The standard Trollheim Teleport spell to Trollheim. Run down the western side of the mountain, using Agility shortcuts (requires level 43 Agility) as needed, then go north up the ramp to the stronghold's main entrance.
Run from Fremennik Province lodestone or AJR to the secret entrance (climbing boots and partial completion of the Troll Stronghold quest required)
Run from Burthorpe to the southern entrance (climbing boots to climb the rocks and partial completion of the Troll Stronghold quest required)

Run from Burthorpe lodestone to the main entrance (climbing boots required; this route is not recommended because it is long and players may be vulnerable to ranged attacks from thrower trolls, or are required level 47 Agility to go through the shortcuts.)

The main entrance to the stronghold is situated west of Trollheim, found atop a small slope, east of the small camp of trolls. This entrance takes you directly to the top floor of the stronghold. Players can get to Trollheim by using the standard magic spell Trollheim Teleport. The Lunar spell Trollheim Farm Teleport teleports the player onto the roof of the stronghold, next to the farming patch.

There is also a southern entrance unlocked during the quest Troll Stronghold, found situated in a mountain passage between Burthorpe and the Fremennik Province (climbing boots are required to climb the rocks). This entrances grants access to the stronghold's lowest level, where the trolls keep their prisoners.
